verses: David gathered all the leaders of Israel, the tribal leaders, the commanders of the divisions that served the king by rotation, the commanders of the thousands, the commanders of the hundreds, the officials who oversaw all the king's property and possessions and those of his sons, along with the officers, the mighty men, and all the brave men, to Jerusalem.

Then King David stood up and said, "Listen, my brothers and my people: I had it in my heart to build a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and I had prepared for the construction."
But God said to me, "You must not build a house for my name, because you are a warrior and have shed blood."

Nevertheless, the LORD God of Israel chose me, before anyone in my father's house, to be king over Israel forever: for he has chosen Judah to be the ruler, and from the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among my father's sons he favored me to be king over all Israel.
And of all my sons— for the LORD has given me many sons— he has chosen my son Solomon to sit on the throne of the LORD's kingdom over Israel.
And he said to me, "Your son Solomon will build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him as my son, and I will be his father."
Moreover I will establish his kingdom forever, if he remains faithful to keep my commandments and my judgments, as he does today.

Now therefore, in the presence of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and before our God, keep and seek all the commandments of the LORD your God, that you may possess this good land and leave it as an inheritance for your children forever.

# And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a wholehearted and willing mind: for the LORD searches all hearts and understands all the thoughts and intentions; if you seek him, he will be found by you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
Pay attention now; for the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
# Then David gave his son Solomon the pattern of the porch, the houses, the treasuries, the upper chambers, the inner rooms, and the place of the mercy seat,

and the pattern of everything he had received by the spirit: the courts of the house of the LORD, all the surrounding chambers, the treasuries of the house of God, and the treasuries of the sacred items.
Also for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work of service in the house of the LORD, and for all the service vessels in the house of the LORD.
He gave gold by weight for items of gold, for all instruments of every kind of service; also silver for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service.

Including the weight for the gold lampstands and their gold lamps, by weight for each lampstand and its lamps; and for the silver lampstands by weight, both for the lampstand and for its lamps, according to the use of each lampstand.
And by weight he gave gold for the showbread tables, for each table; and likewise silver for the silver tables.
Also pure gold for the food hooks, the bowls, and the cups; and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for each basin; and likewise silver by weight for each silver basin.
And for the incense altar, refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the cherubim's chariot, whose wings spread out and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
All this, David said, the LORD made me understand in writing by his hand on me, even all the works of this pattern.

And David said to his son Solomon, "Be strong and courageous, and do it; do not be afraid or discouraged, for the LORD God—my God—will be with you; he will not fail you or forsake you until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD."

And, look, the divisions of the priests and Levites, they will be with you for all the service of the house of God; and with you will be every willing skilled person for all kinds of workmanship, for any kind of service; also the princes and all the people will be wholly under your command.
